title: JSFL final gaps: reorderScene, findItemIndex, mouse stubs, xmlToUI stubs, expandFolder, showLayerMasking
description:
Add final missing JSFL surface to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. library.findItemIndex(name: string): number — REAL: return state.doc.library.items.findIndex(i => i.name === name). Returns -1 if not found. Add to JsflLibrary interface and makeLibraryProxy.

2. doc.reorderScene(sceneToMove: number, sceneBefore: number): void — REAL: moves scene at index sceneToMove to be before sceneBefore. Use array splice on state.doc.scenes to reorder, push via state mutation helper. Check if a core function exists for scene reordering first.

3. doc.mouseClick(x: number, y: number, bAutoSelect?: boolean, bToggleSelection?: boolean): void — console.warn stub.

4. doc.mouseUp(x: number, y: number): void — console.warn stub.

5. doc.mouseDown(x: number, y: number): void — console.warn stub.

6. fl.xmlToUI(xmlString: string): any — console.warn stub, return null. Add to JsflFl interface.

7. fl.xmlToUIRef: null — getter returning null. Add to JsflFl interface.

8. timeline.expandFolder(bExpand: boolean, bApplyToChildren?: boolean, layerIndex?: number): void — console.warn stub.

9. timeline.showLayerMasking(layerIndex?: number): void — console.warn stub.

For item 2 (reorderScene), do an immutable doc mutation: create a copy of scenes, splice out the scene at sceneToMove, splice it back in at sceneBefore, then push the updated doc.
